name: search_files
description: Search for a text pattern across files in a directory tree. Returns matching lines as path:line_number: text rows. Skips binary files and the .git directory. Use this to find where a symbol is defined, which files reference a string, or whether a pattern appears anywhere in the repo — faster and more reliable than printing whole files.

pattern.description: The text pattern to search for (grep basic regex).

path.description: Directory or file to search. Defaults to the current working directory.

glob.description: Only search files matching this glob pattern (e.g. "*.sh", "*.json"). Omit to search all files.

max_results.description: Maximum number of matching lines to return. Defaults to 100.
